question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class WebChat shortcut or prompt-snippet browser, and which surface should own shortcut definitions and storage?
rationale: The request is useful WebChat ergonomics, but implementation would add product surface plus storage/config/API choices that current code does not assign to a canonical owner.

options.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
options.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, plugin, or UI-storage metadata contract before building the panel so shortcut discovery has one source of truth.

options.title: Keep shortcuts browser-local
options.body: Implement a Control UI-local shortcut list with local profile storage or import/export, avoiding gateway config while limiting cross-device sharing.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Hold this until generic Control UI plugin-panel direction is settled, then make shortcuts a plugin or bundle surface if that boundary wins.

recommendation.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
recommendation.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, plugin, or UI-storage metadata contract before building the panel so shortcut discovery has one source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the closest current Control UI command-discovery and slash-command UX surfaces, making them the best available routing candidate for the UI/product shape.
